verses.text: “Do you think you’re in the right? Are you saying, ‘I’m more righteous than God,’
when you ask, ‘What advantage is it to you? What do I gain over what I’d have gained if I’d sinned?’
I’ll answer you and your friends too.
Look up at the skies. See how high the clouds are above you.
If you sin, what does that do to him? If you pile up offenses, what have you done to him?
If you’re righteous, what have you given him? What does he get from your hand?
Your wickedness can hurt somebody like you, and your righteousness can help another human being.
“People cry out under so much oppression. They call for help against the arm of the powerful.
But nobody says, ‘Where’s God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,
who teaches us more than the animals on earth and makes us wiser than the birds in the sky?’
They cry out, but no one answers because of the arrogance of evil people.
God won’t listen to an empty cry. The Almighty won’t pay attention to it.
How much less when you say you can’t see him! Your case is before him, so wait for him.
But now, because he hasn’t come in anger and doesn’t pay much attention to arrogance,
Job opens his mouth with empty talk and piles up words without knowing what he’s talking about.”
